claim: The fastest Paris Gare de l'Est to Reims train is 46 minutes, average 2h3m, with about 18 trains per day over 129 km, fares from about $23.
quote: Fastest journey time: 46 minutes ... Average journey time: 2 hours 3 minutes ... Trains per day: 18 trains per day ... Distance: 80 miles (129 km) ... Cheapest fare: from $23.20 ... Operators: TGV, TER, and SNCF

claim: Cheap advance Paris-Reims tickets start around 4-5 euros on TGV INOUI / TER, with the route served by TGV INOUI, TER and Train Nomad.
quote: book a cheap train ticket from Paris Gare de l'Est to Reims station from $6 (€4) with TGV INOUI, SNCF TER, and TGV

claim: Champagne-Ardenne TGV station sits in Bezannes about 5 km south of Reims, while Gare de Reims is the older downtown station also served by TGV trains.
quote: located in Bezannes ... situated about five kilometres south of Reims ... The station is also served by the Reims tramway ... There are also TGV trains to Gare de Reims, the older station in downtown Reims

claim: Reims has a two-line tramway opened in 2011 over 11.2 km with 24 stops; Line A runs every 5-6 minutes through the centre and central station, Line B (every ~22 min) diverts to the Champagne-Ardenne TGV station at Bezannes.
quote: opened in April 2011 ... 11.2 kilometres of route ... 24 stops ... Line A ... trams running approximately every five to six minutes ... Line B ... turns to reach the Champagne-Ardenne TGV station at Bezannes, with trams running approximately every 22 minutes

claim: The official Reims tourist office says visitors can get anywhere in the city by tram, bus or 100% electric city shuttle, with public transport included in the Reims Epernay Pass.
quote: get anywhere in Reims! By streetcar, bus or city bus (100% electric shuttle) ... Public transport is included in the Reims Epernay Pass ... Most of these trains accept bicycles on board

claim: Late spring (May-June) and early autumn (September-October) are considered the best times for Champagne tours and vineyard visits, with the September vendange (harvest) a particular draw.
quote: Late spring (May-June) and early autumn (September-October) are the best times for champagne tours and vineyard visits, with autumn being particularly exciting due to the vendange (grape harvest)

claim: The warmest and sunniest stretch in Reims runs roughly mid-May to mid-September, making it the overall best weather window.
quote: The best time to visit Reims runs from mid-May to mid-September, since it is the warmest and sunniest period of the year

claim: Reims is about 45 minutes from Paris by high-speed train and is compact and walkable, mixing royal history, Roman remains, architecture and Champagne houses.
quote: Reims is just 45 minutes from Paris by high-speed train and is compact and walkable, combining royal history, Roman remains, serious architecture, and prestigious Champagne houses

claim: A typical Reims weekend pairs a morning Champagne-house cellar tour and tasting with the cathedral and old town, and advises booking major houses like Taittinger and Veuve Clicquot 1-2 days ahead as Saturdays fill fast.
quote: Book champagne cellar tours 1-2 days ahead, especially for weekends, as major houses (Taittinger, Veuve Clicquot) fill up fast on Saturdays
